items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 7 at 1:35PM AKDT until May 9 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Annette Island.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 1 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can bring hazardous conditions for mariners.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 7 at 10:24AM AKDT until May 7 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is possible.

* WHERE...Manley

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- The Nenana Ice Classic tripod toppled on Monday, May 4th, and
the breakup front continues to progress downstream towards
Manley. Water levels at Manley are rising and ice is starting
to shift. As the ice is mobilized, the potential for an ice
jam below Manley exists.

- Http://www.weather.gov/aprfc

items.description:

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued May 6 at 4:46PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Snow, heavy at times, will make travel difficult. During the
daylight hours on Wednesday and Thursday, snow will likely melt as
it makes contact with the ground making things mostly wet and
slushy. Wednesday night however, snow accumulations will be around
3 to 6 inches and accumulations on the Richardson Highway is
likely. Expect travel to become difficult Wednesday night into
Thursday morning with improvement expected Thursday afternoon.
